pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal dark regions with smooth pixel gradients at the edges. Patches on the flank demonstrate greater spatial area and rounded vertices compared to the more elongated and frequent patches on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of cream-colored negative space. Junction nodes are primarily trifurcations. The pixel width of the pathways is relatively uniform across the visible flank and neck sections, maintaining topological continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A short-haired mane along the neck ridge creates a high-frequency, low-amplitude 1D serrated silhouette against the background sky.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, linear, light-colored horizontal scar is visible on the mid-flank, transecting a large dark patch.
